A document type is notified only while its Notification record is enabled, # so the toggle in Notification stays the single source of truth and nothing # is sent for a document type that has been switched off. # These Notification records are the on/off switches for this script -- do not # delete them, or that document type stops notifying entirely. notification_names = { 'Passport': 'Passport Expiry Notification', 'EID': 'EID Notification', 'Visa': 'Visa Expiry Notification', 'Vaccine Card': 'Vaccine Card Expiry Notification', 'Driving License': 'Driving License Expiry Notification', 'RTA Driving Permit': 'RTA Driving Permit Expiry Notification', 'Labor Card': 'Labor Card Expiry Notification', 'Insurance': 'Insurance Expiry Notification', } notification_name = notification_names.get(document_name) if not notification_name: return if not frappe.db.get_value('Notification', notification_name, 'enabled'): return if emp_doc.reports_to : rep_doc = frappe.get_doc("Employee",emp_doc.reports_to) phon = '' email = '' if rep_doc.personal_email : email = rep_doc.personal_email if rep_doc.cell_number : phon = rep_doc.cell_number frappe.sendmail( # Dear Team,

This is to notify that the following document for {emp_doc.employee_name} [Emp ID: {emp_doc.name}] is near to expire:

1. {document_name} Number- {document_number} Expiry Date: {expiry_date}

In order to comply with the company policies, this document should be renewed within {days_left} days of receiving this notification.

In case of any failure to renew the document, you may face consequences including suspension from your job but are not limited to.

For any further information related to the process, please contact the HR Dept. or your reporting manager.({rep_doc.employee_name} {email} {phon})

""", reference_doctype=emp_doc.doctype, reference_name=emp_doc.name ) else : frappe.sendmail( # recipients='ghaith.albarmawi@sowaan.com', # recipients='sufyan.sadiq@sowaan.com', recipients=all_emails, subject=f"{document_name} - Expiry Notification ({notification_number}) - Employee ID {emp_doc.name}", message=f"""
